content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On Sales Invoice (new), a tab or link control near the top-left (about x=125, y=100) appears to route to customer:list, and each return to sales invoice:new is followed by a loading overlay and a console error, so users re-open the invoice screen during one task.", "fix": "Fix: On the Sales Invoice (new) screen, change the top-left tab/link at about (125,100) that navigates to customer:list so it does not unmount the form, for example by opening the customer list in a side panel or new tab, or by keeping the draft state across the route change.", "cited_event_ids": ["271", "273:265", "app:1", "303:w288", "app:2", "8", "275:275", "app:4"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The identity and label of the tab or link at (125,100) are not given in the events; it is inferred from the pointer position and the navigation that follows.", "Whether the customer:list navigation is intended by design or is a bug is not visible.", "The content of the console errors and the purpose of the overlay are not shown.", "Only the first 20 seconds of three sessions are included, so the full task flow and outcome beyond this window are unverified.", "The insight reports no abandonment and no time lost, so the severity of the impact is not confirmed by the windows."]}
